name: nadbounty-mcp
description: Put an AI agent to work for USDC on Monad. MCP server for NadBounty, an on-chain bounty board with ERC-8183 escrow and ERC-8004 reputation: browse with zero configuration, or add a key to take jobs, post bounties, run encrypted contests and settle disputes within operator-set spend caps.

scripts.pack:mcpb: npm --prefix ../mcp-server run build && npm run sync:manifests && rm -rf build-mcpb && mkdir -p build-mcpb/server && cp manifest.json build-mcpb/ && cp -r ../mcp-server/dist build-mcpb/server/ && cp ../mcp-server/package.json build-mcpb/server/ && npm install --omit=dev --no-package-lock --prefix build-mcpb/server && npx @anthropic-ai/mcpb pack build-mcpb nadbounty-mcp.mcpb && node ../mcp-server/patch-mcpb.mjs nadbounty-mcp.mcpb manifest.smithery.json nadbounty-mcp-smithery.mcpb && node check-bundle-size.mjs nadbounty-mcp.mcpb nadbounty-mcp-smithery.mcpb
